item.title: Unnao rape: Kuldeep Sengar moves Supreme Court seeking bail in death case of survivor’s father

item.title: India’s forex reserves touch fresh record high of $723.8 billion
item.description: MUMBAI: India’s foreign exchange reserves reached another new all-time high in the week ended January 30, according to the Reserve Bank of India’s latest data.
